senses.gloss:
--(कौशिक) a royal sage who knew the yoga powers of Hari;
1: भा. I. १९. 9: II. 7. ४४. वा. ९१. ६५-6.
the son of कुशाम्बु(a) (कुशनाभ- वा। प्।) Indra incarnate. His daughter was सत्यवती whom the ब्राह्मण R2ci1ka wanted to marry. गाधि thought him unsuitable and asked for a bride-fee of a thousand horses white like the moon and with one ear black. This condition was satisfied with the help of वरुण, and ऋचीक got her married. गाधि's wife took the consecrated चरु intended for her daughter and became the mother of a Brahmavit, by name विश्वामीत्र.
2: भा. IX. १५. 4-१०: १६. २८ and ३२. Vi. IV. 7. ११-16.
He was desirous of more territory on the earth.
3: भा. XII. 3. 9.
Son of कुशिक, wife Paurukutsi.
4: Br. III. ६६. ३५. ५८.
